messages.message: [vize:css/no-display-none] Consider using v-show directive instead of display: none
messages.help: v-show toggles visibility without removing from DOM, improving performance for frequent toggles

messages.message: [vize:css/prefer-logical-properties] Consider using logical properties for better RTL support
messages.help: Use logical properties like margin-inline-start instead of margin-left

messages.message: [vize:css/no-hardcoded-values] Consider using a CSS variable for this color value
[vize:css/no-important] Avoid using !important as it makes styles harder to override
messages.help: Use more specific selectors or reorganize CSS specificity instead

messages.message: [vize:vue/single-style-block] Consider merging multiple style blocks into one
messages.help: Multiple style blocks of the same type can be merged for better organization
